description: This file implements the SASLprep profile (RFC4013) of the stringprep algorithm (RFC3454) for processing Unicode strings, including normalization, mapping, and bidirectional conformant processing, primarily used in security or identity contexts within a PDF security module.

classes.name: SASLprep
classes.description: A class providing static methods to process strings according to RFC4013 SASLprep profile, including mapping, normalization, and bidirectional checks.

methods.name: PrepareStoredString
methods.description: Prepares a string for storage by applying the SASLprep profile, disallowing unassigned code points.

methods.name: PrepareQuery
methods.description: Prepares a string for querying purposes by applying the SASLprep profile, allowing unassigned code points.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Core processing method that performs mapping, normalization, and bidirectional validation based on input parameters.

methods.name: IsNonAsciiSpace
methods.description: Checks if a character is a non-ASCII space character as per stringprep specifications.

methods.name: IsCommonlyMappedToNothing
methods.description: Checks if a character is commonly mapped to nothing in stringprep specifications.

methods.name: IsProhibited
methods.description: Checks if a code point is prohibited in SASLprep based on various stringprep categories.

methods.name: IsAsciiControlCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a character is an ASCII control character.

methods.name: IsNonAsciiControlCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a code point is a non-ASCII control character.

methods.name: IsPrivateUseCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a code point is in the private use area.

methods.name: IsNonCharacterCodePoint
methods.description: Checks if a code point is a non-character code point.

methods.name: IsSurrogateCodePoint
methods.description: Checks if a code point is a surrogate code point.

methods.name: IsInappropriateForPlainTextCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a code point is inappropriate for plain text.

methods.name: IsInappropriateForCanonicalRepresentationCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a code point is inappropriate for canonical representation.

methods.name: IsChangeDisplayPropertyDeprecatedCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a code point is deprecated for display property changes.

methods.name: IsTaggingCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a code point is a tagging character.

methods.name: IsRandAlCat
methods.description: Checks if a code point has bidirectional property 'R' or 'AL' for bidirectional checks.

methods.name: IsLCat
methods.description: Checks if a code point has bidirectional property 'L' for bidirectional checks.
